name: draft.filter.usedAtIsNull
title: Field: draft.filter.usedAtIsNull
description: Meaning of the publish-consumption filter in seller draft queries.
meaning: Filter by whether the draft was already consumed by publish.
text:
# draft.filter.usedAtIsNull

TL;DR:
- true means only drafts that were not consumed by publish yet.
- false means only drafts that already have usedAt set.
